title: Engine-study closure checks and global constraints (constraints/1)
description: One file per engine study at cad-studies/<study>/constraints.json, evaluated by cad_pipeline/constraints.py (python scripts/check_constraints.py). This schema documents the shape; cad_pipeline.constraints.validate() enforces it and the two additional rules a schema cannot say: every check names a declared source and gives `where`, and every check carries a tolerance unless it is declared `unknown`. Guide: docs/constraints.md.

note.description: How the figures were read and what was not.

python_path.description: Repository-relative folders added to sys.path before a `python` binding is imported.

sources.description: Where published figures come from. `repo` is always available for model-side locators.

bindings.description: Values read from the repository, by name. Every binding carries a locator.

locator.description: The file and line, or the field, the value is read from.

select.description: json: a/b[field=value]/c. [f=v] first match, [f==v] every match, [f^=v] every prefix match; a name over a list maps; a number indexes.

pattern.description: regex: the first match; group 1 (or the whole match) is parsed.

attr.description: python: dotted attribute path in the module.

args.description: python: call with these; '$' is replaced by the foreach item.

where.description: Page and item, figure, or file and line.

verified.description: How it was read: page image, OCR text, carried over from a named record, file.

tolerance.description: abs is in the published figure's unit (or `unit`); rel is a fraction; the larger applies.

unknown.description: A legal state: the reason the check cannot be evaluated. Nothing is invented.

evaluate.description: With `unknown`: still compute the check and show the figure, without judging it.

max_ratio.description: mass groups: ratchet; a ratio above this fails.

accepted.description: A failure that is reported and does not fail the run. If the check later passes, the stale record fails the run.

requires.description: Check ids that must pass first; otherwise this check is unknown.

anchors.description: Source lines a literal in this check was read from; if one stops matching the check is unknown.

check.description: Inputs depend on the kind: compare {actual, expected, family?}; displacement {cylinders, bore, stroke, stated}; power {cylinders, strokes_per_cycle, bore, stroke, speed, stated_power, pressure | solve:'pressure', expect_pressure}; ratio {actual, expected, direction: with|against}; formula {vars, expr, expect: {min,max} | {equals} | {true}}; sequence {expected, actuals}; firing-intervals {cylinders, strokes_per_cycle, order, phases | step_deg [+ phase_order: the order the model's code uses]}; tdc {cylinders, order, phases, pins_at_zero, bore_points, pin_at_zero, pin_at_probe}; numbering {forward, up, bore_points, stations, expect: {odd_side, numbered_from}}; rotation {model: {pin_at_zero, pin_at_probe, axis, forward}, anchor: {part, direction}, chain: [{link: rigid|external-mesh}]}; mass {volumes: {geometry, record}, densities_g_cm3, default_density_g_cm3, groups: [{id, patterns, published | at_most, tolerance, accepted}], totals}.
